title: Ngizim language — Grokipedia
text: Ngizim is a West Chadic language of the Afro-Asiatic family, spoken primarily by the Ngizim people in Yobe State, northeastern Nigeria, with speaker estimates ranging from 80,000 (as of 1993) to 191,000 (as of 2016).
